name: ConversationalAIOutputShowcase
description: The Conversational AI Output Showcase is the primary educational reference for the Wave 1 AI component library. It presents all 18 components — 8 atoms and 10 groups — in a single scrollable page that explains the three-tier experience model, maps components to their primary surfaces, provides a live pattern gallery with scaled previews, and walks through a complete end-to-end AI Led workflow. The page is designed to be shared with product designers, engineers, and AI product managers as an on-boarding and decision-support resource.
intent: The definitive reference for Wave 1 conversational AI output patterns. Maps every atom and group component to its experience tier, surface, behaviour verbs, and accountability tokens — with live interactive examples.
